title: pisum sativum subsp. humile
intro: Pisum sativum subsp. humile, commonly known as garden pea or Lathyrus humilis, is a sub-species of the Pisum sativum plant. This plant has been found to have various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Pisum sativum subsp. humile include its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent, making it useful in the treatment of various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
